name: print-social-flyer-lime-black-agency-sticker-badges
title: Lime-green agency flyer with sticker-style service badges
whatItIs: A lime-green A5 flyer for a creative agency, featuring a black content card with a scalloped/cloud-shaped corner cutout, and six numbered service items in blue/orange sticker-badge shapes.
whatItMeans: Rendering each list item as a distinct hand-drawn 'sticker' badge rather than plain text rows makes a services list feel collectible and playful, matching a youthful agency brand voice.
techniques: render list items as irregular sticker/badge shapes instead of a plain bulleted list
cut a scalloped cloud-shaped notch into a card corner for a hand-crafted, non-rigid feel
use one bright unifying background (lime) so black-and-badge content pops with maximum contrast

vocabulary.definition: a small irregularly-outlined shape styled to resemble a physical sticker, used to highlight short text
